The Federal Reserve is expected to maintain the benchmark overnight interest rate in the 3.50% to 3.75% range, with no immediate impact from the retail sales data on monetary policy.

web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's May economic data reveals a weakening retail sector, with retail sales falling 0.6% from the previous year, marking the first decline in over three years. This downturn is attributed to a slump in the property market and weak consumer demand. Meanwhile, industrial output showed resilience, and urban fixed-asset investment contracted 4.1% year-on-year, primarily due to the real estate sector.
